ConfigurationGuide: Tracked in git and MUST NOT contain secrets: every secret-shaped value here is an empty string. Jwt/RefreshToken/Identity/EmailConfirmation/PasswordReset/EmailChange are configured here only because AddIdentityModule validates them at startup — this host never authenticates anybody, but composing it also composes ASP.NET Identity's full configuration surface. Email is configured here for the same reason, one module over: AddEmailModule validates it at startup because IReminderNotifier's mail adapter lives there, even though this host sends no confirmation mail of its own. See docs/CONFIGURATION.md.
